notes: Adult female witch, eight independently generated views; left images are never reflected.
Staff and mechanical arms remain attached to the torso; the articulated gait moves two separately owned legs and boots.
Profile source feet overlap. Broad polygon erases both source remnants from body, while texturePolygon isolates one foreground boot. The hidden leg reuses that same-facing single-leg texture.
Rear hair and profile gauntlet occlusion polygons preserve the original overlap above animated thighs.
All anatomical joint coordinates are native packed source pixels. Source art is generated with builtin image_gen, packed by trimming and uniform scaling only.

Profile and rear upper thighs are partially hidden by the original gauntlets, garter and long hair. Those upper source pixels remain with body; only clearly visible lower thigh/boot pixels enter moving leg textures. This avoids hair/gauntlet fragments and duplicate garters following both legs.
Small standing-boot outline remnants are explicitly erased from the body without touching the separate moving texture. The down-right thigh silhouette includes its full visible outer edge.
Light-background QA also removes low-alpha standing-foot contour fragments down to alpha 3. Hip texture bleed is disabled to avoid capturing neighbouring coat and glove pixels.
